title: Bitfinex Securities completes record $50M tokenized capital raise
summary: Bitfinex Securities completed a record $50 million raise for Alkemya, whose token represents interests in a partnership that holds nickel assets.

title: Bithumb wins 2 suits over mistaken Bitcoin credits: Report
summary: Bithumb reportedly won first-instance rulings in two suits seeking proceeds from users who sold Bitcoin credited in its $40 billion error.

title: Core Lightning confirms multiple vulnerabilities, prepares security update
summary: Core Lightning advised operators to use offline mode if they do not install the forthcoming update, keeping their nodes active but disconnected.

title: Bitcoin ETF inflows slow to $232M as BTC holds under $80K
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed to $232.1 million as an eight-day streak reached $2.8 billion, while XRP funds posted their biggest inflow since Jan. 5.

title: Tokenized deposits could raise US credit costs: Dallas Fed economists
summary: Dallas Fed economists said faster, programmable deposits could make bank funding less stable, potentially pushing lenders toward more expensive funding.

title: StarkWare tests quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction on mainnet
summary: StarkWare said the experimental transaction demonstrated quantum-resistant Bitcoin spending without a fork, but it cost up to $200 and required direct miner submission.

title: Better launches Bitcoin-backed mortgages powered by Coinbase
summary: Better and Coinbase have launched a crypto-backed mortgage product that lets US homebuyers pledge Bitcoin as collateral for a down payment without having to sell it.

title: Chainalysis estimates $457B in taxable crypto activity, says CARF misses most
summary: The blockchain analytics firm said just 14% of the onchain activity it identified is covered by the OECD’s international crypto tax-reporting framework.
